concerns.text: Phase 7 (T055-T057) implements 'Stabilization Phase', 'Recall Stability' benchmark, and biological mapping. These mechanisms are explicitly removed as 'scope creep' in the tasks.md notes and are not authorized by spec.md (which defers binding architectures and plasticity). No task exists to implement the spec's required FR-011 (Interference Distance) logic for the baseline comparison in US-3, as T024 is the only metric task and T057 is an unauthorized addition.

Phase 8 (T058-T060) implements a 'formal axiomatic statement' of mapping f:(x,y)->AttentionMechanism and a 'Computational Cost Profiler'. The spec.md Assumptions explicitly state 'explicit binding architectures are deferred' and 'alternative metrics... are not tested'. T058 and T059 implement unauthorized mechanisms. No task covers the spec's FR-011 requirement for the non-spatial baseline comparison in US-3, as T024 is the only metric task and T057 is an unauthorized addition.

Phase 9 (T061-T063) implements 'Spatial Coherence Score' and 'Falsification Criterion'. The spec.md explicitly defers alternative metrics and states 'only the Interference Distance metric (FR-011) be used for structural validation'. T061 implements an unauthorized metric. No task covers the spec's FR-011 requirement for the non-spatial baseline comparison in US-3, as T024 is the only metric task and T057 is an unauthorized addition.

Task T024 implements the interference distance metric but does not explicitly cover the 'non-spatial baseline' comparison required by FR-011 and US-3 ('report this metric for both spatial and non-spatial variants'). While T024 mentions 'separately for the spatial variant and the non-spatial baseline', the task description focuses on the spatial variant's implementation. A dedicated task or explicit sub-task for the baseline comparison logic is missing to ensure FR-011 is fully satisfied.

Tasks T055-T063 are tagged with [US3] but implement mechanisms (Stabilization, Spatial Coherence, Formal Mapping) that are explicitly removed as scope creep in the 'Notes' section of the same file and not present in spec.md. These are stale tags referencing non-existent requirements in the current spec.
